title: Nine Minutes of Celebrating
subtitle: 节日庆典 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 节日庆典（文学艺术与体育·节日与庆典）
meta: 主题语境：节日庆典（文学艺术与体育·节日与庆典）　|　核心词汇：anniversary　|　正文 365 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 anniversary 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 my grandparents did not mark their ① anniversary, which was the ninth, and my mother said not marking it was the only way they had ever marked anything. A ② wedding anniversary, my grandmother said in 1974, is a day on which a woman is thanked for something she has not stopped doing; an anniversary, she said, is a day that asks a question you cannot answer.

The ③ anniversary of the shop, meaning fifty years, was in 1971, and they had a cake and no speeches and closed at noon. They ④ celebrated the anniversary for nine minutes and then opened again, and my grandfather said celebrating is the only thing a shop cannot afford to do properly; every anniversary, he said, is nine minutes long and the rest is the other fifty years.

In 1979, ⑤ on the anniversary of her brother's death, she went to work as usual and came home at five, and nobody in the house said anything for nine hours. The ⑥ anniversary itself, meaning the day and not the remembering, had been the same day every year since 1946, and she said a day that comes back is the only kind of clock she trusted; an anniversary, she said, is the only clock that tells one time.

There was ⑦ a twenty-fifth anniversary in 1984, which my mother called the silver one and my grandmother called the one where you stop counting. Every ⑧ anniversary card in the shop sold on the same nine days of the year, and she said a card for a day you have forgotten is the only honest kind of trade; an anniversary, she said, is the only thing a shop sells that nobody wants to be reminded of.

The  anniversary I would mark, if I marked one, is not the ninth or the fiftieth or the silver one, but 1979, when she worked as usual and came home at five. An  anniversary, my mother said in 1996, is the only day in the year on which a family is required to remember something it has spent the rest of the year forgetting; the anniversary of a death, she said, is the only one that belongs to the living.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 周年纪念（活动／日子）
C. n. 结婚周年；婚龄纪念日
E. 固定搭配：a wedding anniversary 结婚纪念日
F. 固定搭配：the anniversary of ... ……的周年纪念日
G. 固定搭配：celebrate / mark an anniversary 庆祝／纪念周年
H. 固定搭配：on the anniversary of ... 在……的周年纪念日

items.q: A wedding anniversary, my grandmother said
celebrated the anniversary for nine minutes
on the anniversary of her brother's death
The anniversary itself, meaning the day
Every anniversary card in the shop

answers.why: anniversary 意为“周年纪念日”，1969 年祖父母没有过他们的第九个周年纪念日。
a wedding anniversary 意为“结婚纪念日”，祖母说结婚纪念日是女人因为一件从未停下的事而被感谢的日子。
the anniversary of ... 意为“……的周年纪念日”，1971 年是铺子开业五十周年。
celebrate an anniversary 意为“庆祝周年”，他们把这个周年只庆祝了九分钟就又开门营业。
on the anniversary of ... 意为“在……的周年纪念日”，1979 年她哥哥去世周年那天，她照常上班。
anniversary 意为“周年纪念（日子）”，自 1946 年起，那个纪念日每年都是同一天，指的不是记忆而是那一天。
anniversary 意为“结婚周年”，1984 年那个二十五周年，母亲叫它银婚。
anniversary 作定语，意为“周年的”，铺子里每一种周年纪念卡都在一年中同样的九天里卖出去。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1969 年祖父母没有过他们的第九个周年纪念日，母亲说“不过”就是他们一向的过法。（anniversary）
1974 年祖母说，结婚纪念日是女人因为一件她从未停下来的事而被感谢的日子。（a wedding anniversary）
1971 年是铺子的五十周年，他们吃了蛋糕，没有致辞，中午就关了门。（the anniversary of）
他们把这个周年只庆祝了九分钟，然后又开门营业。（celebrate an anniversary）
1979 年，在她哥哥去世的周年纪念日那天，她照常上班，五点到家。（on the anniversary of）
1984 年有一个二十五周年——母亲叫它银婚，祖母叫它“你不再数的那一个”。（anniversary）
answers: In 1969 my grandparents did not mark their anniversary, which was the ninth.
A wedding anniversary, my grandmother said in 1974, is a day on which a woman is thanked for something she has not stopped doing.
The anniversary of the shop, meaning fifty years, was in 1971, and they had a cake and no speeches.
They celebrated the anniversary for nine minutes and then opened again.
On the anniversary of her brother's death in 1979 she went to work as usual and came home at five.
There was a twenty-fifth anniversary in 1984, which my mother called the silver one.
